title: Hotel Name, Heritage & Brand
content: Grand Cleopatra Hotel is an authentic boutique hotel established in 1975, located in Gezira El Bairat on the peaceful West Bank of Luxor, Egypt. It is renowned for authentic Egyptian hospitality, rooftop Nile vistas, and close proximity to ancient Thebes monuments. Official domain: https://grandcleopatrahotelux.com.

title: Reception & Contact Details
content: Grand Cleopatra Hotel reception operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Phone: +20 100 345 6789. WhatsApp: +20 100 345 6789. Email: info@grandcleopatrahotelux.com and reservations@grandcleopatrahotelux.com. Address: Gezira El Bairat, Al Qarna, West Bank, Luxor 85951, Egypt.

title: West Bank Location & Nile Ferry Access
content: The hotel is located in Gezira El Bairat on the West Bank of Luxor. It is situated just 250 meters (a 3-minute walk) from the local public Nile ferry station, which operates 24/7 every 10-15 minutes connecting directly to the East Bank (in front of Luxor Temple) for a cost of approx. 10 EGP (~$0.20 USD). GPS coordinates: 25.6989° N, 32.6321° E.

title: Proximity to Ancient Theban Monuments
content: The hotel is exceptionally close to all West Bank monuments: Colossi of Memnon is 2.4 km (5 mins by car); Medinet Habu is 3.5 km (7 mins by car); Valley of the Kings is 5.8 km (12 mins by car); Temple of Hatshepsut is 6.1 km (10 mins by car); Valley of the Queens is 4.8 km (9 mins by car); Ramesseum is 3.2 km (6 mins by car). Luxor International Airport (LXR) is 26 km away (approx. 30 mins).

title: Available Room Types & Suites Overview
content: Grand Cleopatra Hotel offers three verified room categories: 1) Deluxe Double Room ($48/night, 28 m², max 2 guests, King or 2 Twin beds, en-suite bathroom), 2) Triple Room ($65/night, 36 m², max 3 guests, 3 beds, mountain views, en-suite bathroom), and 3) Single Room with Terrace ($38/night, 22 m², 1 guest, private outdoor sun terrace with hot air balloon views). All stays include complimentary rooftop Egyptian breakfast and free Wi-Fi.

title: Deluxe Double Room
content: The Deluxe Double Room accommodates up to 2 guests and is 28 m² (301 ft²). Bed configuration: 1 extra-large king double bed or 2 twin beds. Amenities include silent air conditioning & heating, en-suite private bathroom with walk-in rain shower, flat-screen satellite TV, minibar, electric kettle with complimentary tea and coffee, soundproofing, and lush garden or partial Nile view. Base starting rate: $48 USD per night (subject to season, includes complimentary rooftop breakfast).

title: Triple Room
content: The Triple Room accommodates up to 3 guests and is 36 m² (388 ft²). Bed configuration: 3 single beds or 1 double bed plus 1 single bed. Amenities include silent air conditioning & heating, large en-suite private bathroom with 24/7 hot water, sitting nook, wardrobe, electric kettle with tea and coffee, and scenic views toward the Theban Mountains. Base starting rate: $65 USD per night (subject to season, includes complimentary rooftop breakfast).

title: Single Room with Terrace
content: The Single Room with Terrace accommodates 1 guest and is 22 m² (237 ft²). Located on the upper hotel level, it features a private walk-out sun terrace furnished with outdoor table and seating, offering panoramic views of date palms, West Bank village rooftops, and morning hot air balloons. Includes 1 super single bed with Egyptian cotton linens, silent air conditioning, private en-suite bathroom, writing desk, electric kettle, and free Wi-Fi. Base starting rate: $38 USD per night (includes complimentary rooftop breakfast).

title: Complimentary Rooftop Egyptian & Continental Breakfast
content: A complimentary traditional Egyptian and Continental breakfast is served every morning from 06:30 AM to 10:30 AM on the panoramic rooftop terrace. The spread includes freshly prepared hot falafel (taameya), seasoned fava beans (ful medames) with cumin and olive oil, fresh local baladi bread, eggs cooked to order, white cheeses, cucumber, tomatoes, black honey with tahini, and hot tea or coffee. Takeaway breakfast boxes are prepared on request for early morning (04:00 AM) hot air balloon flights.

title: Panoramic Rooftop Restaurant & Café
content: The rooftop restaurant is open daily from 06:30 AM until 11:00 PM, serving freshly prepared authentic Egyptian home-style cuisine including tagines, grilled meats, spiced rice, fresh mezze salads, and fresh mango juice or Egyptian mint tea. Guests enjoy 360-degree views across the Nile River and the Theban mountains, especially at sunset.

title: Swimming Pool Policy (No Pool on Site)
content: Grand Cleopatra Hotel does NOT have a swimming pool on site. As a traditional boutique heritage hotel on the West Bank, it focuses on rooftop panoramic dining, quiet garden relaxation, and personalized cultural excursions. The AI must never state or imply that the hotel has a pool.

title: Complimentary High-Speed Wi-Fi
content: Free high-speed fiber Wi-Fi is provided throughout the entire property, including all guest rooms, public hallways, reception, and the outdoor rooftop restaurant terrace.

title: Airport & Train Station Private Transfers
content: The hotel provides private 24/7 chauffeured air-conditioned transfers between Luxor International Airport (LXR) and the hotel for a fixed fee of $20 USD per vehicle (up to 4 passengers). Train station transfers are also available. Drivers meet guests at the arrival terminal with a personalized name placard. Booking in advance via reservation inquiry or WhatsApp is recommended.

title: Tour Desk, Hot Air Balloons & Nile Felucca
content: The front desk concierge arranges bespoke excursions with licensed Egyptologist guides to the Valley of the Kings, Karnak, and Hatshepsut. Sunrise hot air balloon rides over Luxor can be booked directly through certified flight partners (approx. $45 USD per person including hotel pickup). Sunset Nile felucca sailboat sails with Egyptian tea are arranged directly from the hotel's riverside mooring.

title: Check-in and Check-out Times
content: Standard check-in time starts at 14:00 (2:00 PM). Check-out time is by 12:00 (noon). Early check-in or late check-out is subject to room availability upon arrival. Complimentary secure luggage storage is provided 24/7 at the front desk.

title: Cancellation Policy & Payment Methods
content: Direct reservations enjoy free cancellation up to 48 hours prior to arrival. Payment is settled on arrival at the hotel. Accepted currencies: Egyptian Pounds (EGP), US Dollars (USD), and Euros (EUR). Major credit cards (Visa and MasterCard) as well as cash are accepted.

title: Pets & Smoking Policy
content: Pets are strictly not allowed on the hotel premises. Smoking is strictly prohibited inside all enclosed guest bedrooms and indoor corridors; however, smoking is permitted in open-air outdoor areas such as private balconies and the rooftop terrace.

title: Group Bookings & Event Inquiries
content: For group reservations exceeding 4 rooms or private rooftop events, special custom rates and terms apply. This requires explicit confirmation by hotel management based on seasonality and capacity.

title: Live Availability & Booking Confirmation Policy
content: Cleopatra AI does NOT have direct access to real-time room inventory and cannot promise live availability or confirm reservations. To check real-time availability and receive a confirmed reservation, guests must complete the Reservation Inquiry Wizard at /reservation or message the 24/7 reception team directly on WhatsApp (+20 100 345 6789).
